items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you were talking about ‘80s pop music, well over here we were absolutely nuts about Nik Kershaw. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: I’ve got two answers for you. The first one is not really. My dad doesn’t like – well he likes a bit of trad jazz and he doesn’t like what I do even though he values the fact that I do something which requires a certain amount of skill and discipline. And I think there’s also an element of jealousy or slight envy because I think he really wanted to be a rock & roll pianist and didn’t, he didn’t do that. So I think he’s slightly frustrated as a performer himself. So no, he doesn’t come to see me play. But the…
I’m happy to hear that. And before I go I wanted to say, you were talking about ‘80s pop music, well over here we were absolutely nuts about Nik Kershaw.
